subject.title: [Feature]: Mattermost — Parity improvements (formatting, reactions, rich interactions)

question: Should Mattermost read receipts and user presence become a supported plugin capability, be explicitly descoped, or be split into a narrower canonical issue before implementation?
rationale: Current main lacks the capability, but exposing read receipts or presence affects privacy, event semantics, and likely user-visible defaults, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Split And Define The Contract
options.body: Create or retitle a focused Mattermost presence/read-receipt issue with expected events, privacy/default behavior, docs, and validation before implementation.

options.title: Document As Descoped
options.body: Update Mattermost docs or this umbrella to say read receipts and presence are intentionally unsupported for now.

options.title: Implement Under This Umbrella
options.body: Proceed directly in the Mattermost plugin only if maintainers accept the event, config, and privacy semantics inside this broader issue.

recommendation.title: Split And Define The Contract
recommendation.body: Create or retitle a focused Mattermost presence/read-receipt issue with expected events, privacy/default behavior, docs, and validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already reviewed this umbrella for the same product-scope gap and has recent Mattermost plugin/docs history.
